'''Sneasel Sneak Attack''' (Japanese: '''VS ニューラ''' ''VS {{tt|Nyula|Sneasel}}''), titled '''Sneaky Sneasel''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 93rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the third chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
When [[Professor Elm]] isn't watching, {{adv|Silver}} drops down from the ceiling and snatches a {{i|Poké Ball}} containing a {{p|Totodile}} from the table. As Silver is making his escape, {{Adv|Gold}} and [[Joey]] are trying to enter the lab, so Professor Elm mistakes Gold for the thief. Gold chases after Silver, and [[Aibo]] fights {{TP|Silver|Sneasel}}.

Gold notices on the table that one of the three Poké Balls is missing, and sees that the {{p|Cyndaquil}} inside one of the other Poké Balls is upset that Totodile is missing. As his [[bag|backpack]] full of Poké Balls was stolen earlier, Gold is sympathetic to having a Pokémon friend taken away, so he offers to fight together with the Cyndaquil. He releases it from the Poké Ball, and, not knowing its name, he nicknames it "[[Exbo]]{{tt|*|Explotaro in Chuang Yi's translation}}", after the explosive flames on its back.

Meanwhile, the [[Team Rocket Elite Trio]] is gloating about having stolen [[Joey]]'s backpack, but to their dismay they discover it is Gold's, which does not contain {{adv|Professor Oak}}'s important documents. Frustrated, one of the members tosses the bag aside, and the Poké Ball containing [[Polibo]] rolls away into a river.

==Major events==
* {{adv|Silver}} steals a {{TP|Silver|Totodile}} from [[Professor Elm]]'s laboratory.
* {{adv|Gold}} and Silver meet for the first time.
* Gold takes a {{p|Cyndaquil}} from Elm's desk and nicknames him "[[Exbo]]".
* [[Polibo]]'s {{i|Poké Ball}} rolls away into a river.
{{Adventuresevents}}
{{endspoilers}}
